_note: From a screenshot of barbadosmaritime.com/documents/conventions/ (docs/conventions.png): 26 entries. Grouped and given their usual short names by us (client to approve). Titles are tidied to the conventions' official names; each "check" says what differs from the live page.
intro: The Barbados Government has ratified, and the BMSR adheres to, all major international conventions to date, including but not limited to the following.

groups.name: Safety & navigation
groups.d: Safe ships, safe navigation and maritime security.

items.title: International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea
1978 and 1988 Protocols to the 1974 Convention on Safety of Life at Sea
International Convention on Load Lines, and its Protocol of 1988
International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea
International Convention for Safe Containers
International Convention on Maritime Search and Rescue
Convention for the Suppression of Unlawful Acts against the Safety of Maritime Navigation, and its 1988 Protocol

groups.name: Pollution & environment
groups.d: Preventing pollution from ships, and responding to it.

items.title: International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships, 1973, as modified by the Protocol of 1978, as amended: Annexes I, II, III, IV, V and VI
items.check: the live page lists the 1978 Protocol with Annexes I, II, III and V, and separately "MARPOL I, II, III, IV, V & VI"; merged here

items.title: International Convention relating to Intervention on the High Seas in Cases of Oil Pollution Casualties
Protocol relating to Intervention on the High Seas in Cases of Pollution by Substances other than Oil
Convention on the Prevention of Marine Pollution by Dumping of Wastes and Other Matter
International Convention on the Control of Harmful Anti-fouling Systems on Ships
International Convention for the Control and Management of Ships' Ballast Water and Sediments

groups.name: Liability & compensation
groups.d: Who pays, and how much, when things go wrong.

items.title: Convention on Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims
Convention relating to the Carriage of Passengers and their Luggage by Sea, and its 1976 Protocol
1976 and 1992 Protocols to the International Convention on Civil Liability for Oil Pollution Damage
1976 and 1992 Protocols to the International Convention on the Establishment of an International Fund for Compensation for Oil Pollution Damage
International Convention on Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage

groups.name: Seafarers
groups.d: Training, working conditions and welfare at sea.

items.title: International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers, as amended
ILO Merchant Shipping (Minimum Standards) Convention, No. 147
Maritime Labour Convention

groups.name: IMO, trade & communications
groups.d: The organisation itself, port formalities, tonnage, radio and health.

items.title: Convention on the International Maritime Organization, and its amendments of 1991 and 1993
Convention on Facilitation of International Maritime Traffic
International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships
Constitution and Convention of the International Telecommunication Union (Nice, 1989), and the Radio Regulations, 1990
International Health Regulations (Geneva)
